Name: Baal-hanan the Gederite
Summary: Gederite over the olive trees and sycomore trees in the low plains.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 27:28: Gederite over the olive trees and sycomore trees in the low plains.
LifeLesson: The mention of Baal-hanan in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
